items.why: Citi raised its price target to $800 from $575 on AI agent demand tied to Meta's Muse, and Mizuho lifted its target to $705. CEO Lisa Su said AMD will substantially increase chip supply in 2027.
The fear gauge slid as the S&P 500 set a new record high and Treasury yields backed off multi-year peaks, cooling demand for downside hedges.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape. Megacaps rose as dipping Treasury yields and softer oil lifted the market ahead of earnings season, per Reuters.
Gold rebounded from a two-month low as the 10-year yield eased off its 24-year high near 5.35% and the dollar retreated, per Gold Eagle and the WSJ.

market_note: Yields pulled back from a 24-year high and oil fell, giving stocks room to run into earnings season.
summary: The S&P 500 set a new record high Tuesday as Treasury yields dipped from multi-year highs and oil retreated, lifting stocks ahead of earnings season. Chip stocks led on fresh analyst targets while the VIX slid.
